versions.changelog:
- Initial release of 汇报幻灯片生成器 (ym-report-slide-gen).
- Automatically generates HTML slides from weekly or monthly report data, including a conclusion page and data tables with source notes.
- Enforces "conclusion first" structure, limits total slides by presentation duration (5/10/15 minutes).
- Uses only Python standard library; no internet or pip dependencies required.
- Input: structured Markdown with cover, one-page conclusion, core data, weekly progress, risks/support, and plans.
- Output: local, standalone HTML slide deck with keyboard controls and built-in font fallback for cross-platform compatibility.
